subject: Combining display and closed storage
hook: Alcove units, sideboards and bookcases that hide the clutter and show off the good stuff.
gbp:
Most living and dining rooms need two kinds of storage at once: somewhere to hide the everyday clutter and somewhere to show the pieces you love. SUPERIO designs and builds furniture that does both.

That might be alcove units with closed cupboards below and adjustable shelves above, a sideboard with a top that doubles as a serving surface when guests come round, or a bookcase wall with doors at the base. Each piece is designed around your room and what you own, with shelf-pin rows so display shelves can be moved as your collection changes.

Everything is made to measure in our own workshop in Hanley, in finishes including oak-effect, charcoal, matt white and slatted fronts, with antique gold or matt black handles and soft-close hardware as standard. Our own team delivers and installs it, scribing to walls that are not quite straight.

We work with homeowners in Congleton and across the surrounding area. With the hosting season approaching, it is a good time to start planning. Book a free, no-obligation design consultation using the button below.
